title: Automotive Marketing | Why 1 in 5 New Movers Buy a Vehicle Within a Year
summary: Automotive marketers spend a lot of time trying to answer one question: Who's most likely to buy a vehicle next? Many campaigns focus on consumers who are actively shopping online, researching vehicles, or visiting dealership websites. Those are all valuable signals, but one of the most valuable automotive audiences is often overlooked: new movers. Based on PGM's research, Learn why one in five new movers buy a vehicle within the first year after relocating and how dealerships and OEMs can use life events and consumer buying signals to reach high-intent automotive shoppers.
